s0283.logic: 主句为 Another issue is that...，that 引导表语从句。表语从句内部包含一个 while 引导的让步状语从句，主句为 it is not as well represented...。让步状语从句中，climate change 为主语，is well integrated 为谓语，后接两个介词短语 into some subjects 和 at some ages，中间有插入语 such as... 举例说明。主句中，it 指代 climate change，is not as well represented 为谓语，后接两个介词短语 in curricula for younger children 和 in subjects that are more widely taught，其中 that 引导定语从句修饰 subjects，最后 such as biology and chemistry 举例说明。

s0039.abridged_en: The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an important policy interest. Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of equal protection.
s0039.zh: 美国最高法院不赞成基于性别的分类，除非这些分类旨在解决重要的政策利益。由于加州法律适用于所有董事会，即使没有先前歧视的历史，法院也可能裁定该法律违反了宪法对平等保护的保障。
s0039.main_stem_zh: 美国最高法院不赞成基于性别的分类；法院可能裁定该法律违反了宪法对平等保护的保障。
s0039.logic: 句子由两个并列的主句构成，第一个主句后接unless引导的条件状语从句；第二个主句前有Because引导的原因状语从句和even where引导的让步状语从句，主句后接that引导的宾语从句。
s0039.en: The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an important policy interest, Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of equal protection.

s0494.abridged_en: old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit
s0494.zh: 自从老好莱坞与Netflix公司正面竞争以来，它一直努力在流媒体领域盈利，但迪士尼+、孔雀和派拉蒙+等平台每年亏损数十亿美元，这引发了人们对这些服务永远不会像有线电视曾经那样盈利的担忧。

s0494.logic: 先给出时间背景（自从与Netflix竞争），再陈述主句事实（老好莱坞盈利困难），接着用with复合结构补充具体亏损例子，最后用现在分词引出由此引发的担忧（服务盈利性不如有线电视）。

s0453.logic: 句子由but连接两个并列分句：第一个分句提出一种可能性（用眼睛尝试植物），第二个分句指出这种做法的后果（浪费时间和精力），并附加原因状语从句说明为什么尤其浪费。
s0453.en: One possibility was that they merely used their eyes and tried out the plants they found, but that would probably result in a lot of wasted time and energy, not least because their eyesight is actually not very good.

s0537.abridged_en: Butterflies may not pollinate as many plants, but they are an extremely useful indicator.
s0537.zh: 蝴蝶授粉的植物数量可能不如野生蜜蜂和食蚜蝇多，但由于英国蝴蝶是世界上研究最深入的昆虫群体，它们是飞行昆虫更广泛减少的一个极其有用的指标。
s0537.main_stem_zh: 蝴蝶可能不会授粉那么多植物，但它们是极其有用的指标。

s0537.en: Butterflies may not pollinate as many plants as wild bees and hoverflies, but because British butterflies are the best-studied group of insects in the world, they are an extremely useful indicator of the wider declines in flying insects.

s0450.abridged_en: The researchers are convinced that the elephants know where they are in relation to all the resources they need, and can take shortcuts, as well as following familiar routes.
s0450.zh: 研究人员确信，大象总是精确地知道它们相对于所需所有资源的位置，因此能够走捷径，也能沿熟悉的路线行进。

s0675.abridged_en: A return to that version of scientific literacy seems like something society today desperately needs.
s0675.zh: 回归那种科学素养版本——更注重教授科学是什么以及它如何运作，而不是记忆科学事实——似乎是当今社会迫切需要的东西。
s0675.main_stem_zh: 回归那种科学素养版本似乎是当今社会迫切需要的东西。
s0675.logic: 主句为 A return... seems like something...。非限制性定语从句 which focused... 可先括掉。
s0675.en: A return to that version of scientific literacy, which focused more on teaching what science is and how it works and less on memorizing scientific facts, seems like something society today desperately needs.

s0511.zh: 在创作之时，没有人刻意保存，然而模拟材料有机会幸存下来并作为历史记录，传记作者、历史学家和小说家依赖这些记录。

s0511.en: At the time of creation, no attempts were made at intentional preservation, yet analog materials have a chance of surviving and serving as the historical record that biographers, historians, and novelists rely on.

s0676.en: Educators advanced the idea of having students complete detailed laboratory exercises in high schools in the belief that such work was beneficial primarily as a way to enhance logical reasoning and observational skills.

s0285.zh: Branch指出，即使越来越多的官方指南和教科书反映了关于气候变化的科学共识，但传达更片面观点的非官方教育材料正在分发给教师。

s0089.logic: 主句说明政府允许涨价，后接原因和比较。
s0089.en: Successive governments have permitted such increases on the grounds that the cost of investing in and running the rail network should be borne by those who use it, rather than the general taxpayer.

s0224.zh: 如果不会危及就业，在就业保护法限制企业主解雇表现不佳的管理者的程度上，这些法律制约了企业生产率，从而制约了工人工资。

s0224.en: If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers' wages.

s0114.en: They are noting that the Victorians suddenly seem to become more human as the hundred-or-so years that separate us fade away through our common experience of laughter.

s0364.zh: 以对目标客户需求敏感的方式非侵入性地传递营销信息，是数字营销人员面临的关键挑战之一。

s0038.abridged_en: California Governor Jerry Brown admitted the law is unconstitutional.

s0038.main_stem_zh: 州长布朗承认该法律违宪。
discard_notes: In signing the measure (0-3) 为状语，可先括掉
that the law... 中 that 从句为宾语从句，但主干需保留 the law is unconstitutional
which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex (14-22) 为非限制性定语从句，可先括掉
probably (25) 为副词修饰语，可先括掉
s0038.logic: 主句主语为 California Governor Jerry Brown，谓语 admitted，后接 that 宾语从句，从句主干为 the law is unconstitutional，其中 which 引导的定语从句为插入修饰，可先忽略。
s0038.en: In signing the measure, California Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional.

s0496.logic: 主句主干为the rise helped curb piracy，其中rise为主语，helped为谓语，curb piracy为宾语（curb为省略to的不定式作宾语补足语，但此处与helped构成固定搭配，故保留curb和piracy）。
